text:
cody (AE): Hey team — steering a POC with Zephyrus (large fintech). They want SSO/SAML + SCIM bulk sync, RBAC support, delegated domain ownership, and an on-prem connector option for air-gapped vaults. Need tech + pricing help, blockers?

josh (SE): Thanks. Key questions: expected SCIM throughput (users/min), SAML IdP initiators vs SP-initiated, and whether they need SCIM deltas or full imports. Also: do they require SCIM PATCH support for partial updates?

cody (AE): They said ~20k users initial, ~200 updates/min during payroll day. SP-initiated preferred but will do IdP flows for some partners. PATCH support requested.

natasha (Solutions): For 20k + 200/min bursts, recommend Dedicated capacity for provisioning window. Hosted can work for steady low bursts but SCIM delta spikes will risk rate throttling. Pricing note: delta-heavy syncs push us into a higher webhook/requests tier. I can draft an estimate.

leila (Security): Security checklist: SOC2 + ISO27001 proofs are standard. They also asked about KMS/HSM integration for key rotation and the ability to hold logs in their VPC (private deployment). We also need to confirm support for customer-managed TLS certs and mTLS for the on-prem connector.

sam (Presales): For domain controls: Zephyrus wants delegated DNS verification (they can't add TXT records) and org-wide domain delegation. We support: TXT, file-based proof, and OAuth-based domain delegation for supported DNS providers. If they require delegated admin across subdomains we can do tenant scoping with locked domain claims.

josh (SE): On RBAC: confirm we can map SCIM groups -> Redwood roles and preserve nested group semantics. Implementation note: we currently support group membership, role mapping, and custom attribute->role rules. Edge case: nested groups flatten to membership list in the POC unless they want hierarchical permissions enforced by the app.

leila (Security): Also check dataflow: SCIM attributes with PII must be encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest. Audit trails must show actor (SCIM user/service), timestamp, and diff. We can surface per-request audit events to their SIEM via syslog/forwarder. Will confirm retention options.

cody (AE): Does Redwood require them to run the private control plane for KMS/HSM? Or can we integrate with their cloud KMS while they use Hosted?

natasha (Solutions): We can integrate with customer-managed KMS for Hosted but keys must be accessible from our region (no air-gapped). For true air-gapped HSM, they need Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) — that supports HSM/KMS behind their network and offline key material.

sam (Presales): On the SCIM sample: share this quick PATCH example they can test against our staging endpoint — it handles partial updates and group changes.

sam (Presales): ```bash
curl -X PATCH https://staging-api.redwood.dev/scim/v2/Users/{id} \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"emails[type eq \"work\"].value","value":"jane.new@zephyrus.com"}]}'
```

josh (SE): Nice. Also flagging SCIM rate-limiter header behavior so Zephyrus can backoff correctly: we return X-RateLimit-Limit / X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset in epoch seconds on throttled responses. Recommend exponential backoff + jitter.

leila (Security): Questionnaire: I've uploaded answers to the shared drive and ran the initial risk matrix. compliance-bot: security questionnaire (Zephyrus) uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/compliance/zephyrus-qna (doc id 9f3c).

compliance-bot: :white_check_mark: Uploaded security questionnaire and baseline answers. Next steps: customer legal to review redacted SOC2 report and sign DPA addendum.

cody (AE): Great — action items: 1) natasha to produce cost estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted with burst buffer for SCIM; 2) leila to finalize KMS/HSM integration notes + retention; 3) josh to assemble a mini-PoC checklist (endpoints, sample payloads, and test users). I'll loop in Zephyrus AM to schedule a 30m technical call tomorrow. :thumbsup:

natasha (Solutions): On it. I'll push numbers by EOD and include a sample pricing scenario for 1yr reserved capacity.

josh (SE): I'll post the POC checklist in the thread when ready and attach a sample SCIM export.

leila (Security): I'll attach the KMS/HSM matrix and the specific controls they asked for (mTLS, key wrapping, audit export).

cody (AE): Thanks team — will update Zephyrus and book the call.
